description: Read project notes (memories) about files before working on them. Use this when starting work on a file or investigating an area of the codebase to see if there are important notes, learnings, or context that have been saved. Can search by query text, filter by file path, or list all notes.

file_path.description: Filter notes for a specific file path

query.description: Search query to match against note content and file paths

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

name: read_project_notes
